7:1.text: [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings.]

7:2.text: , so let not your breast be narrow therefrom, that you warn thereby; and a reminder unto the believers.

7:3.text: [Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) to these idolaters (pagan Arabs) of your folk:]
Follow what has been sent down unto you from your Lord
(protectors and helpers who order you to associate partners in worship with Allâh)

7:4.text: And a great number of towns
by night or while they were taking their midday nap.

7:5.text: No cry did they utter when Our Torment came upon them but this: "Verily, we were Zâlimûn

7:6.text: Then surely, We shall question those
was sent and verily, We shall question the Messengers.

7:7.text: Then surely, We shall narrate unto them
with knowledge, and indeed We have not been absent.

7:8.text: And the weighing on that day
. So as for those whose scale
will be heavy, they will be the successful

7:9.text: And as for those whose scale will be light, they are those who will lose their ownselves
because they denied and rejected Our Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)

7:10.text: And surely, We gave you authority on the earth and appointed for you therein provisions

7:11.text: (the noble shape of a human being)
; then We told the angels, "Prostrate yourselves to Adam", and they prostrated themselves, except Iblîs
, he refused to be of those who prostrated themselves.
